strings.📎 写给贡献者的页面：这里讲的是本站的内部结构与收录进度，面向想参与维护、扩展算: 📎 A page for contributors: it describes the site's internal structure and inclusion progress, for people who want to help maintain it or extend the algorithms and problems. Just want to use the algorithms or learn? The encyclopedia overview is enough.
strings.算法原子（内核）× 问题原子（ctx 协议）× 声明式注册——每个问题域尽可能对: Algorithm atoms (kernels) × problem atoms (the ctx protocol) × declarative registration — every problem domain should offer as many of the included algorithms as possible. Three atomic adapter layers: bv (bit vectors, sigmoid binarisation), pk (permutations, random keys, Bean 1994) and as (assignment, round + clamp). Every cell must be compared with random search at an equal evaluation budget (see “Equal-budget measurements” below), and cells that do not win reliably are withdrawn.
strings.各域算法概览（合计 {n} 格，其中原子适配 {n} 格）: Algorithms per domain (total {n} cells, of which {n} are atomic adaptations)
strings.原子内核 × 域 覆盖明细（✓ = 该域可跑且过门）: Atomic kernel × domain coverage details (✓ = runs in that domain and passes the gate)
strings.TSP 主域另有 {n} 个专属算法（页面见算法总览）。多目标域为 NSGA 系: The main TSP domain has another {n} dedicated algorithms (see the algorithm library overview). The multi-objective domain uses NSGA-family algorithms; the three scheduling domains (nurse rostering / exam timetabling / fixture generation) use dedicated integer-encoding kernels (swap neighbourhood + integer GA/DE/GWO/CS) — none of them take part in the general atomic kernels, so they do not appear in the table below.
strings.撤下记录：跨域系统性失效的内核（如 GSA 引力项在离散语境退化、HS 记忆考量: Withdrawal notes: kernels that fail systematically across domains (such as the GSA gravity term degrading in discrete contexts, or HS memory consideration under-converging) are withdrawn as a whole family; domain-specific failures are withdrawn cell by cell; the CMA-ES bit / permutation / assignment versions are simplified diagonal-covariance versions.
strings.每个「问题域 × 变体 × 算法」格子都和随机搜索比过一次，而且评估次数相同：算: Every “problem domain × variant × algorithm” cell was compared once with random search at an equal evaluation budget: random search gets as many objective evaluations as the algorithm itself used in a run. {n} generations, {n} instance seeds (the seed also determines the instance, {n}–{n}), median taken; a relative gap within ±{n}% counts as a tie. In total {n} cells: clearly better than random search {n} ({n}%) · tied {n} ({n}%) · worse than random search {n} ({n}%). Cells that lost were re-tested with {n} seeds, and those that still lose are withdrawn ({n} cells, listed below) and no longer appear in the algorithm drop-down.
strings.词条域（调度 / 路径 / 选址 / 图问题 / 黑箱……）: Entry domain (scheduling / routing / location / graph problems / black box…)
strings.怎么读这张表（局限，请读）: How to read this table (limitations — please read)
strings.「胜过随机搜索」是低门槛：它说明算法在这个模型上确实在搜索，不说明它比该问题的专: “Better than random search” is a low bar: it shows the algorithm really searches on this model, not that it is better than a dedicated algorithm for the problem.
strings.只有 {n} 个种子（每个种子是一个新实例）：这是小样本，格子里的结论是这几个实: Only {n} seeds (each seed is a new instance): this is a small sample, and the conclusion in a cell is an observation on these few instances, not a statistically general conclusion. Cells near the margin can flip with another seed (which is why lost cells are re-tested with more seeds).
strings.实例是随机生成的小规模教学实例，不是文献基准；有些问题（如能精确求解的网络流、匹: The instances are small, randomly generated teaching instances, not literature benchmarks; for some problems (such as network flow and matching, which are solved exactly) random search is already strong or no such algorithm should be used at all — they are teaching contrasts here.
strings.撤下不等于「这个算法不好」，只表示在这个模型、这个预算下它没有赢过随机搜索；换预: Withdrawn does not mean “this algorithm is bad”; it only means it did not beat random search on this model at this budget — a different budget, encoding or tuning can change the result.
strings.评估次数相同不等于时间相同：有的算法每次评估之外还有额外开销。: Equal evaluations do not mean equal time: some algorithms have extra overhead besides each evaluation.
strings.撤下是校验制度在运作，不是缺陷：在更严的口径下（随机基线取同一种子下的最优值）过: Withdrawal is the verification system at work, not a defect: an algorithm or kernel that cannot pass a stricter gate (the random baseline taking the best value under the same seed) is withdrawn and recorded. The “Equal-budget measurements” above is the current criterion; this section holds records from earlier batches. {n} records in total: {n} withdrawn, {n} being redone elsewhere.
strings.位向量层 bv（连续系二值化） × gsa（引力搜索）: Bit-vector layer bv (binarised continuous family) × gsa (gravitational search)
strings.位向量层 bv（连续系二值化） × hs（和声搜索）: Bit-vector layer bv (binarised continuous family) × hs (harmony search)
strings.GSA 引力项随距离平方衰减，在二进制 0/1 空间无几何对应，离散化后机制退化: The GSA gravity term decays with the square of the distance and has no geometric counterpart in binary 0/1 space, so after discretisation the mechanism degrades; it did not pass the strict gate against fake runs (it still did not beat the random baseline taking the best value under the same seed).
strings.HS 和声记忆库（记忆考量）在离散位空间收敛不足，种群多样性过早坍缩，未过严口径: The HS harmony memory (memory consideration) under-converges in discrete bit space and population diversity collapses too early; it did not pass the strict gate against fake runs.
strings.收敛不足（未达随机基线）: Under-converged (did not reach the random baseline)
strings.SCA 在 QUBO 大范围负目标（伊辛负能 landscape）探索不足，伯努: SCA explores too little on the wide-ranging negative objectives of QUBO (Ising negative-energy landscape), and under Bernoulli binarisation the positive and negative energy ranges are asymmetric; it did not pass the gate.
strings.MFO 多焰递减机制在 QUBO 负能 landscape 上同样探索不足，与: The MFO decreasing-flame mechanism likewise under-explores the QUBO negative-energy landscape and was withdrawn in the same batch as sca / eo.
strings.EO 平衡池机制在 QUBO 大范围负目标下失效（同 sca/mfo 批），伯努: The EO equilibrium-pool mechanism fails on the wide-ranging negative objectives of QUBO (same batch as sca / mfo); the Bernoulli-family cem / cmaes pass the gate, eo is withdrawn.
strings.MFO 多焰递减机制在组合背包域（change-making 等）不适配，未过防: The MFO decreasing-flame mechanism does not suit the combinatorial knapsack domain (change-making and the like); it did not pass the gate against fake runs.
strings.MFO 在 SAT 布尔域（变量取值 0/1）失效，未过防假跑门。: MFO fails in the SAT Boolean domain (variables take 0/1); it did not pass the gate against fake runs.
strings.EO 在 GAP 指派域 470 vs 427 未过门（域级撤下）；同层 as_: EO did not pass the gate in the GAP assignment domain (470 vs 427; domain-level withdrawal); as_sca of the same layer was fixed and re-attached, while as_eo stays withdrawn on record.
strings.470 vs 427（被测内核 vs 随机基线最优）: 470 vs 427 (kernel under test vs best of the random baseline)
strings.口径说明：内核级撤下=整族机制在离散语境退化（如 GSA 引力项、HS 记忆考量: Notes: a kernel-level withdrawal means the mechanism of a whole family degrades in discrete contexts (such as the GSA gravity term or HS memory consideration); a domain-level withdrawal means an algorithm did not pass the gate in a domain (recorded cell by cell, with evidence in the source comments). Nurse rostering, fixture generation, facility location and the travelling tournament were once withdrawn as entry-level demos and later redone with professional modelling or dedicated kernels and put back after passing the checks; there are currently no entry-level withdrawal records. See the candidate pool for the admission-gate records.
